catalog.name: Slippy Back Pack
catalog.reason: "Slippy" ties directly to the excluded brand Slip Angle / SA. Not Chirp'n3rd.

catalog.name: Slip Patch
catalog.reason: "Slip" belongs to Slip Angle / SA, a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: Mars Sweater
catalog.reason: Named after excluded brand Mars.

catalog.name: Glenn Tri Blend
catalog.reason: Named after excluded brand Glenn.

catalog.name: Hoyle Racing
catalog.reason: Hoyle Racing is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: RAMXBRO
catalog.reason: RAMXBRO is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: Chad G.
catalog.reason: Chad G. is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: ELTANKRENSHA
catalog.reason: Eltankrensha / Eltan is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: Eltankrensha sticker
catalog.reason: Eltankrensha / Eltan is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: Eltan Collage
catalog.reason: Eltan is a named excluded brand.

catalog.name: Embroided Zippy boy
catalog.reason: Not tied to any named excluded brand. An embroidered bird character reads as the Chirp'n3rd chickadee mascot, which is the mark.
catalog.title: Zippy Boy Embroidered Hat
catalog.hook: The bird, stitched thread by thread, riding shotgun on your dome.
catalog.description: This is our little chickadee in a helmet, punched into the panel one stitch at a time. No cheap heat-press junk that peels in the wash bay. Snap it on, crack the windows, and go bang third til the tires cry uncle. Have Fun. Shift Hard.

catalog.name: Sticker sheet
catalog.reason: Sticker sheet is core Chirp'n3rd merch — bird mascot, chirp jokes, slap-on decals. No other brand named.
catalog.title: The Chirp'n3rd Sticker Sheet
catalog.hook: One sheet. Nine ways to bird-bomb your build.
catalog.description: A full sheet of Chirp'n3rd goods — the helmet chickadee, the chirp gags, and a couple you'll fight your buddy over. Slap 'em on your toolbox, your laptop, the inside of your hood. Weatherproof enough to survive a track day and a car wash you shouldn't have paid for.

catalog.name: Shoes?
catalog.reason: Ambiguous placeholder with a question mark — not a defined product, no clear Chirp'n3rd concept or art tied to it. Not something to publish as-is.

catalog.name: Flag
catalog.reason: Garage/paddock flag fits car-culture brand. Bird mark on a wall flag is on-brand. No other label named.
catalog.title: Chirp'n3rd Garage Flag
catalog.hook: Stake your bay. The bird flies here.
catalog.description: Big ol' wall flag for the garage, the paddock tent, or the dorm room you're pretending is a garage. Helmet bird front and center so everybody knows whose bay this is. Grommets in the corners, loud enough to see from across the pits.

catalog.name: .COM
catalog.reason: Not a product — appears to reference the .com / online rebrand (Chirp'n3rd Online), a domain/web concept, not sellable apparel.

catalog.name: Dad Hat
catalog.reason: Classic unstructured dad hat with the bird mark — squarely a Chirp'n3rd lid. No competing brand.
catalog.title: The Chirp'n3rd Dad Hat
catalog.hook: Low profile. High chirp.
catalog.description: Unstructured six-panel with a bent brim you'll ruin perfectly in a week. Little helmet bird stitched on the front, curved bill, that soft crown that sits right after a long day in the bay. Wear it to Cars and Coffee, wear it to change your oil, wear it because your real hair situation is between you and God.

catalog.name: SNAP BACK!
catalog.reason: Snapback cap — obvious Chirp'n3rd lid drop. No other brand tied to it.
catalog.title: Chirp'n3rd Snapback
catalog.hook: Flat brim, flat-out sending it.
catalog.description: Structured snapback, flat brim, keep the sticker on if that's your religion. Helmet bird up front, adjustable snap out back so it fits your buddy's giant head too. Built for the guy who parks nose-out and always has an opinion about your coilovers.

catalog.name: HOODEEZE
catalog.reason: Hoodie (playful spelling) — core apparel piece for the brand. No other label named.
catalog.title: The Chirp'n3rd Hoodie
catalog.hook: Cold starts, warm hoodie.
catalog.description: Heavyweight pullover for cold-morning cold starts and late-night wrench sessions. Helmet bird on the chest, big front pocket for your knuckles when it's 40 degrees in the garage. Soft enough to nap in the driver's seat while the coolant bleeds. Have Fun. Shift Hard.

catalog.name: SCOOTER HOODY
catalog.reason: Scooter/moto humor fits the moto side of the brand voice. Reads as a themed Chirp'n3rd hoodie, no competing brand.
catalog.title: Scooter Gang Hoodie
catalog.hook: Two wheels, zero chill, still chirpin'.
catalog.description: For the days the project car's on stands and you're ripping around on two wheels instead. Moto-flavored graphic, same helmet bird, same bad decisions. Heavyweight pullover that eats wind on the way to grab parts you didn't budget for.

catalog.name: BaseBall Tee
catalog.reason: Raglan baseball tee is standard Chirp'n3rd apparel with the bird/chirp graphic. No other brand named.
catalog.title: Chirp'n3rd Baseball Tee
catalog.hook: Raglan sleeves, redline dreams.
catalog.description: Three-quarter raglan with contrast sleeves and the helmet bird across the chest. Vintage feel, drapes right, hides the fact you've been in the garage since noon. Good for the drive, good for the paddock, good for pretending you'll make it to the batting cage.

catalog.name: Base Ball 3/4
catalog.reason: Three-quarter-sleeve baseball tee — a Chirp'n3rd tee variant. Reads as a duplicate/sibling of #9 but still on-brand; no other label.
catalog.title: Chirp'n3rd 3/4 Sleeve
catalog.hook: The in-between-seasons chirp shirt.
catalog.description: Three-quarter sleeve raglan for that weird garage weather — too warm for the hoodie, too cold for a plain tee. Helmet bird front and center, contrast sleeves, soft-washed so it feels like you've owned it three summers already.

catalog.name: 3/4 For Softball
catalog.reason: Another 3/4 raglan variant — fits as a Chirp'n3rd tee with the same silhouette. No competing brand named.
catalog.title: Chirp'n3rd Softball 3/4
catalog.hook: Beer-league fit, back-road heart.
catalog.description: Same three-quarter raglan we love, cut for the beer-league softball crowd who'd rather be at the track. Helmet bird on the chest, roomy through the body, ready for the after-game parking lot meet where everybody pops a hood. Swing hard, shift harder.

catalog.name: Keep Yo Lid Warm
catalog.reason: Beanie in the garage voice ('lid warm') — clearly a Chirp'n3rd knit cap. No other brand.
catalog.title: Keep Yo Lid Warm Beanie
catalog.hook: Cold garage? Cover the dome.
catalog.description: Cuffed knit beanie for freezing cold starts and no-heat garages. Little embroidered bird on the fold so your dome reps the brand while your breath fogs up the windshield. Fits under a helmet, over bad hair, through every winter wrench session you swore you wouldn't do.

catalog.name: Keep your lid good
catalog.reason: Reads as a beanie/lid sibling to #12 in the same voice. On-brand headwear; no other label. Likely a duplicate concept but still plausibly Chirp'n3rd.
catalog.title: Keep Your Lid Good Beanie
catalog.hook: Dome protection for degenerates.
catalog.description: The everyday knit beanie — pull it low, keep your lid good through the cold months. Embroidered helmet bird on the cuff, stretchy enough for any head, humble enough to lose in the back seat for a month. Basic in the best way.

catalog.name: Slap this on your bumper
catalog.reason: Bumper sticker in pure garage voice — textbook Chirp'n3rd decal. No other brand named.
catalog.title: Bumper Slapper Sticker
catalog.hook: Free real estate for the bird.
catalog.description: The big one, made for your bumper, your hatch, or that one spot on the toolbox everyone stares at. Helmet bird, weatherproof vinyl, sticks through winters and pressure washes. Warning: guaranteed to get a 'sick sticker, bro' at least once a fill-up.

catalog.name: The Bloomer Trucker
catalog.reason: Trucker hat ('The ___ Trucker' naming). 'Bloomer' reads as an internal design name, not a competing brand from the exclude list. Plausibly a Chirp'n3rd lid.
catalog.title: The Bloomer Trucker
catalog.hook: Mesh back, foam front, full send.
catalog.description: Classic foam-front, mesh-back trucker that breathes on hot paddock days. Helmet bird patched up front, snap closure, that perfect bend in the brim after one summer. The one that lives on your headrest and comes out every time somebody says 'let's go for a rip.'

catalog.name: They also makes pants out of this
catalog.reason: Not a real product — a joke placeholder note ('they also makes pants out of this'), no defined garment or graphic to sell.

catalog.name: CH3RD
catalog.reason: Stylized Chirp'n3rd wordmark/plate riff, core brand.
catalog.title: CH3RD Plate Tee
catalog.hook: The only license plate that tells the truth.
catalog.description: Clean CH3RD lettering done up like a vanity plate, because that's basically what your car already is. Third gear, tires loose, front and center. Wear it to cars and coffee and let people do the math. Have fun, shift hard.

catalog.name: Chirp Mask
catalog.reason: Bird mascot as a mask graphic, on-brand.
catalog.title: Chirp Mask
catalog.hook: For when the boost gets loud and so do you.
catalog.description: The helmeted chickadee stares back from a face mask built for garage nights and dusty track days. Half bandit, half bird, all attitude. Good for paint fumes, cold starts, and looking like you mean it.

catalog.name: Chirp'N Shift Boltz
catalog.reason: Shift-hardware branded product, manual/chirp theme.
catalog.title: Chirp'N Shift Boltz
catalog.hook: Hardware that heard third gear and never recovered.
catalog.description: Little branded bolts for the guy who details the bay before he washes the paint. Bird stamped, weighty, and made to live under the hood where only real ones look. Torque them down and know they're there.

catalog.name: Chirpn crest
catalog.reason: Brand crest/heraldry with the bird.
catalog.title: Chirpn Crest Tee
catalog.hook: A family crest for a family that redlines.
catalog.description: Old-world crest energy, garage-built values. The chickadee sits dead center flanked by the stuff that actually matters: a manual gate, a helmet, and a redline. Heritage, but the kind that smells like race gas.

catalog.name: CHiRpn Joggers
catalog.reason: Branded apparel, on-brand.
catalog.title: Chirpn Joggers
catalog.hook: Pants for wrenching, driving, and doing absolutely nothing.
catalog.description: Soft, cuffed, and stitched with the Chirpn mark down the leg. Built for cold garage mornings and the drive home when the seat's still warm. You will wear these more than any pair of pants you own. That's a promise, not a pitch.

catalog.name: Chirp'n Flops
catalog.reason: Branded sandals, on-brand novelty apparel.
catalog.title: Chirp'n Flops
catalog.hook: Paddock footwear for the guy who forgot real shoes.
catalog.description: Slide-on flops with the bird on the strap for trailer life, pit lane, and the walk to the snack stand. Not track legal, extremely paddock legal. Pair with socks and dare somebody to say something.

catalog.name: CHIRP'N NEW NEW
catalog.reason: Fresh drop, brand voice.
catalog.title: Chirp'n New New
catalog.hook: Fresh off the bench, still warm.
catalog.description: The latest thing out of the garage before we overthink it. Limited, loud, and gone when it's gone. If you're reading this it's probably already moving. Don't sleep.

catalog.name: Chirpn Bomber
catalog.reason: Branded bomber jacket, on-brand.
catalog.title: Chirpn Bomber
catalog.hook: Pit crew warmth, street-corner cool.
catalog.description: A proper bomber with the bird patched over the heart and something dumb-good stitched on the back. Cold morning starts, night meets, standing around a running engine talking about nothing. This is the jacket for all of it.

catalog.name: Chirpn Turd
catalog.reason: Crude chirp/turd pun, fits the irreverent garage voice.
catalog.title: Chirpn Turd Tee
catalog.hook: Yeah we went there. It's called third gear.
catalog.description: Say Chirp'n3rd fast enough and this is what your buddy hears anyway. So we put it on a shirt. Dumb, proud, and exactly the kind of joke that lives in a group chat at 1am. If you get it, you get it.

catalog.name: Chirp'r Badge
catalog.reason: Branded badge/sticker, on-brand.
catalog.title: Chirp'r Badge Sticker
catalog.hook: Slap it where the OEM badge used to be.
catalog.description: Die-cut badge sticker of the bird, sized to sit on a fender, a toolbox, or your laptop. Weatherproof enough to survive a full season and a few car washes you forgot to avoid. Peel, stick, chirp.

catalog.name: Chirpn3rd.com
catalog.reason: URL/wordmark tee, brand.
catalog.title: Chirpn3rd.com Tee
catalog.hook: A billboard you can wear to the gas station.
catalog.description: Just the name and the dot-com, big and clean, like an old track tee that accidentally became the whole outfit. It tells people where to find us without you saying a word. Free advertising never fit so good.

catalog.name: BIG BIRD
catalog.reason: Oversized bird mascot graphic, brand mark.
catalog.title: Big Bird Tee
catalog.hook: The chickadee, blown up loud.
catalog.description: The mascot printed big enough to see from the other end of the paddock. Helmet on, attitude up, taking the whole chest. When you want the bird to do the talking, this is the one.

catalog.name: LED BURD
catalog.reason: Bird mascot variant, brand.
catalog.title: LED Burd Tee
catalog.hook: The bird, but somebody left the neon on.
catalog.description: Our chickadee redrawn like a late-night sign glowing over a closed shop. Electric outlines, dark background, the kind of print that looks best under parking-lot lights. Same bird, more voltage.

catalog.name: OG BURD
catalog.reason: Original bird mascot, core brand.
catalog.title: OG Burd Tee
catalog.hook: The one that started the whole flock.
catalog.description: The original hand-drawn chickadee in a helmet, no gimmicks, just the mark that got two guys in a garage this far. If you own one Chirp'n3rd shirt, it's this one. Where it all started.

catalog.name: OG BURD (2nd)
catalog.reason: Second colorway of the original bird; duplicate design, likely alternate color.
catalog.title: OG Burd Tee (Blackout)
catalog.hook: The one that started it, now after dark.
catalog.description: Same original chickadee, flipped to a blackout colorway for the nights you don't want to stand out and somehow still do. If you already own the white one, you know you need this too. The classic, second helping.

catalog.name: Gradient BURD
catalog.reason: Bird mascot with gradient treatment, brand.
catalog.title: Gradient Burd Tee
catalog.hook: Sunset over the on-ramp.
catalog.description: The bird washed in a faded gradient that reads like the sky right before a night drive. Softer, a little dreamier, still very much ready to chirp third. For the days you want the mascot without the shout.

catalog.name: BURDY PHONE CASE
catalog.reason: Branded phone case accessory.
catalog.title: Burdy Phone Case
catalog.hook: Drop it in the garage, the bird takes the hit.
catalog.description: The chickadee on a case tough enough for oily hands and dropped tailgates. Grippy, printed sharp, and just the right amount of obnoxious when you set it face-up on the workbench. Protects the phone, reps the flock.

catalog.name: Knob
catalog.reason: Shift knob, core manual/chirp product.
catalog.title: Chirpn Shift Knob
catalog.hook: The part that does the actual chirping.
catalog.description: A weighted branded shift knob for the hand that lives on it. Threaded to fit most manuals, heavy enough to feel right on the two-three pull, and stamped with the bird because of course it is. This is where Have Fun, Shift Hard actually happens.

catalog.name: Mini Bike Tee
catalog.reason: Mini bike moto humor, fits brand.
catalog.title: Mini Bike Tee
catalog.hook: Small bike, big stupid grin.
catalog.description: Because before the project car there was a mini bike doing 20 and feeling like 200. This one's for the gateway drug that started your whole problem. Send it in the cul-de-sac.

catalog.name: Mini Bike Bros
catalog.reason: Mini bike crew moto humor, brand voice.
catalog.title: Mini Bike Bros Tee
catalog.hook: The crew that ripped curbs before they had licenses.
catalog.description: For the boys who learned throttle control on a frame-flexing mini bike and never really grew out of it. Two little wheels, one bad idea, lifelong friends. Same energy that fills the garage now, just bigger toys.

catalog.name: Better than a FIREBIRD
catalog.reason: Import-vs-Firebird trash talk, on-brand car humor, no excluded brand.
catalog.title: Better Than a Firebird Tee
catalog.hook: Fighting words, screen printed.
catalog.description: Import kid trash talk you can wear to the cruise. No shade to the birds with T-tops, but we chirp a different third gear around here. Guaranteed to start at least one argument at the gas pump. That's the point.

catalog.name: F40 Carrera Roller
catalog.reason: Supercar rolling-shot render — car culture, not tied to any excluded label. Leans exotic rather than core JDM, but still fits the wall-art side of the shop.
catalog.title: F40 Roller
catalog.hook: Analog twin-turbo, zero driver aids, all attitude.
catalog.description: A rolling shot of the last Ferrari that trusted you completely — no traction control, no safety net, just boost and bad decisions. We're Honda guys at heart but we know a poster-worthy silhouette when we see one. Tape it above the workbench and dream a little.

catalog.name: GT3 RS
catalog.reason: Porsche track weapon, pure car culture, no excluded brand. Exotic rather than import but fits poster/tee art.
catalog.title: GT3 RS
catalog.hook: The wing is not a suggestion.
catalog.description: Naturally aspirated, redline in the stratosphere, a rear wing you could serve dinner on. Not our usual driveway build but we respect anything that shows up to the track ready to embarrass everyone. Print it big.

catalog.name: BMW Slide
catalog.reason: Drift/slide car culture, no excluded label. Fits the moto humor and sideways-loving crowd.
catalog.title: BMW Slide
catalog.hook: Rear-wheel drive is a lifestyle, not a layout.
catalog.description: Some cars understeer to the wall. This one waves at it sideways. A tribute to the cheapest way to get a car loose and the most expensive way to keep it that way — tires. Wear it, then go feed the habit.

catalog.name: Vintage Honda
catalog.reason: Core Chirp'n3rd — Honda, import culture, exactly the brand's DNA.
catalog.title: Vintage Honda
catalog.hook: Old iron, high revs, zero regrets.
catalog.description: Before turbos got polite and dashboards got screens, Honda built featherweight things that begged for redline. This is a love letter to the era that started the whole chirp habit. VTEC didn't just kick in, it raised us.

catalog.name: Classic Nardi
catalog.reason: Nardi wheel is a beloved classic import/JDM accessory, not an excluded brand. On-theme cockpit art.
catalog.title: Classic Nardi
catalog.hook: Wood rim, thin spokes, all feel.
catalog.description: A three-spoke wheel that's been bolted into every good build since your grandfather's day. No airbag, no buttons, just a direct line from your hands to the front tires. If you know, you know — and your palms already miss it.

catalog.name: Turek Corrola
catalog.reason: Corolla (import), no excluded brand named. Reads as an enthusiast Toyota build; playful misspelling fits the garage voice.
catalog.title: Turek Corrola
catalog.hook: Spelled wrong, built right.
catalog.description: The most reliable econobox ever made, beaten mercilessly by every kid who couldn't afford anything faster — and it just kept running. Yeah we spelled it funny. So did your buddy's dyno sheet. Cheap, light, immortal.

catalog.name: Carrera GT
catalog.reason: Porsche analog hypercar, car culture, no excluded brand. Exotic but poster-worthy.
catalog.title: Carrera GT
catalog.hook: A V10 that files for a manual license.
catalog.description: Race engine, wooden shift knob, a clutch that separated the brave from the parked. The last hypercar that made you earn it with your left foot. We put a wood knob on our stuff too — theirs just came with 600 horses behind it. Wall material.

catalog.name: Huracan Evo Roller
catalog.reason: Lamborghini rolling render, car culture, no excluded label. Exotic side of the poster line.
catalog.title: Huracan Evo Roller
catalog.hook: Loud on purpose, subtle never.
catalog.description: A screaming V10 wedge caught mid-roll, doing the one thing it was built to do — make everyone look. Not exactly a garage-build hero but it earns its spot on the wall next to the ones we actually wrench on. Print, hang, admire.

catalog.name: NSX
catalog.reason: Honda/Acura NSX — dead-center Chirp'n3rd. JDM icon, no excluded brand.
catalog.title: NSX
catalog.hook: The everyday supercar that shamed the exotics.
catalog.description: Honda took notes from Senna, built a mid-engine legend you could daily, and quietly humbled a paddock full of Italians. This is the one that proves import guys were right all along. Wear it like the flex it is.

catalog.name: Rockin for Falken
catalog.reason: Falken is a tire sponsor common in drift/import culture, not on the excluded list. Fits tire-and-tread humor.
catalog.title: Rockin for Falken
catalog.hook: Sponsored by the tire budget you don't have.
catalog.description: Every sideways hero flies the tire-brand flag, so here's ours. A nod to the blue-and-red sidewalls that die a heroic death every weekend so you can look cool for eleven seconds. Buy the shirt, then buy the tires. Again.

catalog.name: Double Stanged
catalog.reason: Stance-culture wordplay, no excluded brand. Fits the insider import humor.
catalog.title: Double Stanged
catalog.hook: Camber so aggressive it needs a warning label.
catalog.description: For the crew who aired out, tucked tire, and rubbed fender at every driveway. Function optional, fitment mandatory. If your alignment guy sighs when you pull in, this one's for you. Slammed and proud.

catalog.name: Period Correct
catalog.reason: Genuine enthusiast phrase for era-accurate builds; not named among excluded labels, so treating as generic car-culture wording. Mild caution — it echoes an existing apparel name.
catalog.title: Period Correct
catalog.hook: No zip ties, no modern shortcuts, all era.
catalog.description: The purist's badge — every part right for the year, nothing anachronistic bolted on to cheat. For the builder who'd rather hunt a swap meet for six months than run a repro. Correct down to the valve stem caps.

catalog.name: What is this thing even?
catalog.reason: Garage-humor one-liner, fits Chirp'n3rd's irreverent insider voice. No excluded brand.
catalog.title: What Is This Thing Even?
catalog.hook: Every mystery bracket you found under the intake.
catalog.description: The universal question asked over every parts-bin gremlin, orphan connector, and rattling bracket nobody remembers installing. If you've held up a rusty part and squinted, congrats, you're one of us. Wear the confusion proudly.

catalog.name: Hell Kitty
catalog.reason: JDM sticker-culture Hello Kitty parody — classic import-scene humor, no excluded brand.
catalog.title: Hell Kitty
catalog.hook: Cute face, straight-piped soul.
catalog.description: The import scene's favorite mascot, but she's been to the track and she's angry about the tire prices. Slap her on the window, the toolbox, or the pizza box lid. Peel, stick, misbehave.

catalog.name: Ridin Dirty
catalog.reason: Car-culture phrase, fits the crude-but-fun garage voice. No excluded brand.
catalog.title: Ridin Dirty
catalog.hook: Brake dust, bug guts, and a check-engine light for flavor.
catalog.description: For the daily that never sees a wash bay because there's always a mod to finish first. Fenders full of road grime, trunk full of tools, and zero shame about any of it. Clean car, dirty conscience — nah, other way around.

catalog.name: Take no responsibility
catalog.title: Take No Responsibility
catalog.hook: The tires did it, not me.
catalog.description: When the back end steps out and somebody asks who chirped it into 3rd through the neighborhood, you saw nothing. This one's for the guy who builds the car, sends it, and blames physics. Have fun, shift hard, admit nothing.
catalog.reason: Irreverent garage-attitude line that fits the chirp/manual joke and the send-it-blame-nothing car-guy voice.

catalog.name: Don't blame me
catalog.title: Don't Blame Me
catalog.hook: It was in gear. That's on the car.
catalog.description: Second gear, third gear, and a decision or two you'd rather not explain to your insurance guy. Slap this on and let the tires take the heat. Two guys in a garage approve this message.
catalog.reason: Same send-it/deny-it garage humor as the brand's bad-decisions lane; plausibly Chirp'n3rd.

catalog.name: Wide open or Die
catalog.title: Wide Open Or Die
catalog.hook: Part throttle is for cowards.
catalog.description: There's no half-send here. Foot flat, ears ringing, chickadee riding shotgun in the helmet. Wide open throttle is the only setting we ship. Have fun. Shift hard.
catalog.reason: Wide-open-throttle racing phrase, core motorsports/car-culture territory.

catalog.name: Win or die
catalog.title: Win Or Die
catalog.hook: No podium, no point.
catalog.description: Race day math is simple: you either take the win home or you take the walk of shame back to the trailer. This one's for the crew that treats a Tuesday grudge run like the last lap at the 'ring. Send it or sit down.
catalog.reason: Race-day competitive slogan; fits the motorsports voice and isn't tied to a named brand.

catalog.name: Winning is everything
catalog.title: Winning Is Everything
catalog.hook: Second place is first loser.
catalog.description: We didn't wrench until 3am to come in second. Bolt-on this attitude and go collect. It's not the only thing, it's everything.
catalog.reason: Race-day competitive line consistent with the brand's grudge-run humor.

catalog.name: Winning is everything sticker
catalog.title: Winning Is Everything - Sticker
catalog.hook: Slap it on the toolbox, not the bumper.
catalog.description: Small vinyl reminder for the roll cage, the laptop, or the cooler you keep in the paddock. Winning is everything and now it's peel-and-stick. Weatherproof enough for track days.
catalog.reason: Sticker version of an in-scope race-day slogan.

catalog.name: Winning crew
catalog.title: Winning Crew
catalog.hook: Roll deep, roll fast.
catalog.description: You don't chirp 3rd alone, you do it with the crew that helped you bleed the brakes at midnight. This one reps the whole pit, not just the driver. Bring the whole garage.
catalog.reason: Crew/pit-team car-culture theme fits the garage brand.

catalog.name: Crew!
catalog.title: Crew!
catalog.hook: For the ones who show up with jack stands.
catalog.description: The people who answer the 'can you come hold a flashlight' text at 11pm. That's the crew. Wear it loud. No crew, no chirp.
catalog.reason: Reads as car-crew shorthand, in scope for the garage/pit-crew voice.

catalog.name: Bad life decisions
catalog.title: Bad Life Decisions
catalog.hook: Financed the turbo, not the couch.
catalog.description: Every good project car started as a bad life decision and got worse from there. Boost leaks, budget leaks, and zero regrets. If you know, you know, and your wallet knows.
catalog.reason: The build-a-car-instead-of-adulting joke is squarely Chirp'n3rd's lane.

catalog.name: OG Motorsports
catalog.title: OG Motorsports
catalog.hook: Been sending it since carbs.
catalog.description: For the ones who were bleeding knuckles on import builds before it was a hashtag. Old-guard motorsports, hand-drawn bird, no gatekeeping, just respect. Have fun, shift hard, remember where it started.
catalog.reason: Generic motorsports/heritage theme, not a named excluded brand; fits import car culture.

catalog.name: Truck it bro!
catalog.title: Truck It, Bro!
catalog.hook: When in doubt, truck it.
catalog.description: Sometimes the answer isn't finesse, it's send it and figure out the alignment later. Automotive send-it energy with a straight face. Bro-approved, tire-not-approved.
catalog.reason: Automotive send-it pun with the bro-humor register the brand plays in.

catalog.name: Badge it bro
catalog.title: Badge It, Bro
catalog.hook: Debadge? Never met her.
catalog.description: Some guys shave every emblem off. You? You add more. Badges on badges, stanced and proud, chickadee in the corner. It's a car-guy inside joke and you're on the inside.
catalog.reason: Badge/debadge is a genuine car-culture inside joke; fits the brand.

catalog.name: You are a nerd
catalog.title: You Are A N3rd
catalog.hook: Say it like it's an insult. It's not.
catalog.description: Yeah, you know your spool from your VE table and you'd rather read a boost log than a menu. Chirp'n3rd was built by n3rds who love the stupid loud stuff. Wear the label. The 3 is on purpose.
catalog.reason: Plays directly on the 'n3rd' in Chirp'n3rd - strong brand fit.

catalog.name: Trend Bro

plan.summary: Launch plan for Chirp'n3rd Online (THE GARAGE group). 63 of 101 classified products are INCLUDED, sorted into 9 storefront collections, each mapped to a Y2K AOL buddy-list screen name. 38 products are EXCLUDED — generic bro/novelty filler with no car-culture or chirp hook, non-products/placeholders (Shoes?, .COM, "they also makes pants out of this"), and anything named after an excluded outside brand (Slip Angle, Mars, Glenn, Hoyle Racing, RAMXBRO, Chad G., Eltankrensha). The launch set is 12 pieces balancing the confirmed bird/chirp core (OG Burd, Big Bird, Zippy Boy, CH3RD plate, Crest, sticker sheet, shift knob, flagship hoodie) with the strongest car-culture designs (NSX, Vintage Honda, Better Than a Firebird, You Are A N3rd). Note two duplicate-concept pairs that should ship as alternate colorways rather than separate SKUs: OG Burd / OG Burd (2nd), and the two beanies (Keep Yo Lid Warm / Keep your lid good). Product names use the classified-set "name" field as canonical IDs.
